active_ingredient: Active ingredient (in each 5ml tsp.) Guaifenesin USP 100 mg Purpose Expectorant
dosage_and_administration: Directions Do not take more than 6 doses in any 24 hours period Adults and children 12 years and over Take 2-4 teaspoonful (5mL) every 4 hours Children under 12 years Consult a physician
dosage_and_administration_table:
Adults and children 12 years and over Take 2-4 teaspoonful (5mL) every 4 hours
Children under 12 years Consult a physician
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients Citric acid, FD&C yellow #5, glycerin, methylparaben, potassium sorbate, propylene glycol, propylparaben, purified water, sodium citrate, strawberry-banana flavor, sucralose.
indications_and_usage: Uses • helps loosen phlegm (mucus) and thin bronchial secretions to make coughs more productive
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
pregnancy_or_breast_feeding: If pregnant or beast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.

spl_unclassified_section: Other information • store at room temperature • 15°-30°C (59°-86°F) Do not use if seal under cap is torn, broken or missing. TAMPER-EVIDENT:
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if • cough persists for more than a week, tends to recur, or is accompanied by a fever, rash or persistant headache, consult a doctor. A persistent cough may be a sign of a serious condition.
warnings: Warnings Do not take this product for persistent or chronic cough such as occurs with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, or emphysema, or where cough is accompanied by excessive phlegm(mucus) unless direct by a doctor." Stop use and ask a doctor if • cough persists for more than a week, tends to recur, or is accompanied by a fever, rash or persistant headache, consult a doctor. A persistent cough may be a sign of a serious condition. If pregnant or beast-feeding, ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
